visual_thesis: A vibrant Japanese sushi kitchen bar aesthetic featuring glossy nigiri, dark nori rolls, bamboo tatami mats, and polished lacquerware.
art_style: Glossy casual 3D render with vibrant colors, soft ambient occlusion, and clean rim lighting

banner.text: SAVE THE KING FROM THE WASABI
